reproduction.expected: A ChatGPT or Codex wrapper can drive one verified Starter request from bounded semantic selection through exact confirmation, one TaskRun start, and repeated Host/external/human resumes using one durable session identity.
reproduction.actual: Selection, runtime start/resume, TaskRun projection, and Host request/result evidence exist only as separate APIs. No durable session controller owns their ordering, correlates them, or exposes one closed next-action contract.

violated_invariants: A Host integration must not create a second TaskRun or restart a waiting Workflow.
Natural-language selection and mutating confirmation must remain bound to one exact verified candidate and effect preview.
Host, external-event, and human-gate resumes must match the active durable wait identity.
Graph END must remain TaskRun VALIDATING and must not become completion or merge.
